newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Albertson's cut to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Albertson's cut to neutral.

text.p: --Jensen Securities Co said Monday it cut its recommendation on Albertson's Inc to neutral from outperform in reaction to company comments that third and fourth quarter earnings will likely be flat with the $0.42 and $0.61 reported for the same periods last year.
--said it expects EPS for Q3 and Q3 to be $0.42 and $0.61 respectively and EPS for FY1996 and FY1997 to be $1.96 and $2.20 respectively.
